001package com.streamconverter.web;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
006import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
007import org.slf4j.Logger;
008import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
009import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBuffer;
010import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DefaultDataBufferFactory;
011import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBufferUtils;
012import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
013import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
014import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
015import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
016
017import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
018import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
019import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
020import com.streamconverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
021import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
022import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
023import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
024
025import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
026import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
027
028/**
029 * Web API controller for StreamConverter processing.
030 *
031 * <p>Provides REST endpoints to process data streams using existing StreamConverter functionality.
032 */
033@RestController
034@RequestMapping("/api/v1/stream")
035public class StreamProcessingController {
036
037  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamProcessingController.class);
038
039  /**
040   * Process data stream with CSV extraction.
041   *
042   * @param inputData binary input data
043   * @param columnName CSV column name to extract
044   * @return processed data as binary stream
045   */
046  @PostMapping(
047      value = "/csv/extract",
048      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
049      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
050  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processCsvExtraction(
051      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String columnName) {
052
053    log.info("Processing CSV extraction for column: {}", columnName);
054
055    return Mono
056        .fromCallable(
057            () ->
058                ResponseEntity.ok(
059                    processWithStreamConverter(
060                        inputData,
061                        CsvNavigateCommand.create(
062                            CSVPath.of(columnName), new PassThroughRule()))))
063        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Process data stream with JSON path extraction.
068   *
069   * @param inputData binary input data
070   * @param jsonPath JSON path expression
071   * @return processed data as binary stream
072   */
073  @PostMapping(
074      value = "/json/extract",
075      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
076      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
077  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processJsonExtraction(
078      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String jsonPath) {
079
080    log.info("Processing JSON extraction for path: {}", jsonPath);
081
082    return Mono
083        .fromCallable(
084            () ->
085                ResponseEntity.ok(
086                    processWithStreamConverter(
087                        inputData,
088                        JsonNavigateCommand.create(
089                            TreePath.fromJson(jsonPath), new PassThroughRule()))))
090        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Process data stream with custom command pipeline.
095   *
096   * @param inputData binary input data
097   * @param pipelineConfig pipeline configuration header
098   * @return processed data as binary stream
099   */
100  @PostMapping(
101      value = "/process",
102      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
103      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
104  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processWithPipeline(
105      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData,
106      @RequestHeader("X-Pipeline-Config") String pipelineConfig) {
107
108    log.info("Processing with pipeline config: {}", pipelineConfig);
109
110    return Mono
111        .fromCallable(
112            () ->
113                ResponseEntity.ok(
114                    processWithStreamConverter(
115                        inputData, buildPipelineFromConfig(pipelineConfig))))
116        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Health check endpoint.
121   *
122   * @return simple health status
123   */
124  @GetMapping("/health")
125  public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
126    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("StreamConverter Web API is running"));
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Processes data using StreamConverter with given commands in a streaming fashion.
131   *
132   * @param inputData reactive stream of input data buffers
133   * @param commands stream commands to execute
134   * @return processed output as Flux of DataBuffer
135   */
136  private Flux<DataBuffer> processWithStreamConverter(
137      Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, IStreamCommand... commands) {
138    DefaultDataBufferFactory bufferFactory = new DefaultDataBufferFactory();
139    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
140    return Flux
141        .from(
142            DataBufferUtils.outputStreamPublisher(
143                outputStream -> {
144                  try (InputStream inputStream =
145                      DataBufferUtils.subscriberInputStream(inputData, 4096)) {
146                    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(commands);
147                    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
148                  } catch (IOException e) {
149                    throw new RuntimeException("Stream processing failed", e);
150                  }
151                },
152                bufferFactory,
153                executor))
154        .doFinally(signalType -> executor.shutdown());
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Builds a pipeline from configuration string.
159   *
160   * @param config pipeline configuration (e.g., "csv:name,json:$.result,process:validator")
161   * @return array of stream commands
162   */
163  private IStreamCommand[] buildPipelineFromConfig(String config) {
164    String[] commandConfigs = config.split(",");
165    IStreamCommand[] commands = new IStreamCommand[commandConfigs.length];
166
167    for (int i = 0; i < commandConfigs.length; i++) {
168      String[] parts = commandConfigs[i].split(":", 2);
169      String commandType = parts[0].trim();
170      String parameter = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].trim() : "";
171
172      commands[i] =
173          switch (commandType.toLowerCase()) {
174            case "csv" -> CsvNavigateCommand.create(CSVPath.of(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
175            case "json" -> JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
176            case "process" -> (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
177            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown command type: " + commandType);
178          };
179    }
180
181    log.info("Built pipeline with {} commands", commands.length);
182    return commands;
183  }
184}
